messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — ACME just pushed a scope change. They want the POC to include Private deployment + BYO-KMS after the security review. Asks: updated pricing (dedicated vs private), timeline extension, and confirmation that we can reach 50 rps with p95 < 350ms. Need recommendation by EOD Fri.

liam: Short answer: we can probably hit 50 rps. Long answer: depends on model variant, quantization, and KV/cache hit rate. With 4xA10G, bs=8 and warmed KV cache we saw p95 ~280ms on our internal perf runs. BYO-KMS will add crypto round-trip (20-80ms) depending on HSM network hops.

sophie: For the security questionnaire: they want key rotation policy, HSM attestation, and audit log retention. We support external KMS integrations and have audit logs in Private. I'll draft a redlined response.

anna: Pricing note: Private (VPC) + BYO-KMS is typically a 25–40% uplift vs Dedicated due to added infra and support. Recommend we propose a 2-week POC extension and a short pilot fee to cover provisioning.

liam: Action plan for perf validation: I'll run a mini-benchmark with a KMS latency stub to simulate HSM + our caching strategy. Test matrix: model=A-compact, model=B-quant, bs=[1,4,8], rps target=50, kv_cache=on/off. ETA 24h.

maya: Thanks. Customer also wants success criteria spelled out. My suggestion: (1) functional parity: top-3 prompt templates return acceptable quality on their eval set, (2) performance: sustained 50 rps with p95 < 350ms (including KMS simulated overhead), (3) stability: no more than 1 error per 10k requests, (4) cost: projected unit cost within their budget delta. Thoughts?

liam: Agree. Add a short eval harness: run 2000 prompts from their set, measure rouge/accuracy-like metric + manual spot checks. Also include ``--simulate-kms=true`` flag in the harness to get realistic latency numbers.

sophie: I'll attach the KMS FAQ snippet and HSM attestation template to the questionnaire draft. Also recommend we offer a short architecture diagram for Private deployment (network flows, KMS path, NAT/inbound rules).

anna: For pricing wording: propose two options in the SOW — (A) Dedicated reserved for POC (fastest to stand up, lower cost) with optional BYO-KMS via proxy (+estimated latency); (B) Private deployment (VPC) with direct HSM integration and higher one-time provisioning fee. I'll write the numbers after liam's perf run.

deploy-bot: provision-request created: req-4521 for ephemeral private cluster (4xA10G), owner=liam, expires_in=14d.

liam: Got the req. I'll queue the run and post results here. If KMS overhead >100ms we should propose client-side caching of envelope keys to reduce per-request HSM hits.

maya: Next steps: 1) liam runs perf + posts results (24h), 2) sophie finishes questionnaire answers + attestation template (tomorrow AM), 3) anna drafts two-option pricing + proposed 2-week extension (tomorrow PM). If all good we'll present to ACME on Tue.

anna: I'll also prepare a short slide with tradeoffs (latency vs security vs cost) — send to me any numbers you want highlighted.

liam: Quick data teaser from the run (preliminary): bs=8, kv_cache=on => 50 rps sustained, p95=295ms without KMS; simulated KMS add ~35ms. Posting full log in a follow-up.

maya: Perfect — this is enough to recommend: offer Private demo with measured KMS latency, propose 2-week extension, and two-option pricing. I'll draft the customer email after anna's pricing. :thumbsup:

sophie: Uploaded questionnaire draft to the shared drive and added the HSM attestation PDF. Link: https://redwood.internal/drive/acme-poc (internal)

maya: Closing loop — great triage team. We'll keep the channel for any last-minute blockers.
